items.event: DP World Tour Championship (Dubai), Race to Dubai finale
items.line: Race to Dubai leader Eugenio Chacarra plays Rory McIlroy (about 534 pts back) in the final pairing on Thursday. Patrick Reed is close behind them. A win would give McIlroy an 8th Race to Dubai title, tying Colin Montgomerie's record. The winner gets $3M.
items.whenJst: Thu Nov 12 – Sun Nov 15 · final round ends ~21:00 JST Sun (approx.)

items.event: Nitto ATP Finals, Turin: draw and opening day
items.line: The groups are drawn today. The field is Alcaraz, Zverev, Shelton, Medvedev, Cobolli, Fils, Tiafoe and Jodar, and 2025 champion Sinner is not in it. Round-robin singles start Sunday, and the final is Sun Nov 22 at 02:00 JST Mon.
